notes.title: FRENCH & SPANISH (LATAM) TRANSLATIONS AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The French and Spanish (LATAM/MX) fan translations are ready and available! 

Because the new 1.08 version will unfortunately break the save game compatibility, I'm going to release it first as an optional beta version.

[b]HOW TO ENABLE THE 1.08 VERSION:[/b]
[olist]
[*] In the Steam library, right-click Dreams in the Witch House.
[*] Select "Properties..."
[*] Select "Betas"
[*] Select "beta - Version 1.08" from the Beta Participation drop-down menu
[/olist]
That's it! The new version should start to download immediately. 

[b]Version 1.08 Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added translations to French and Spanish (LATAM/MX) 
[*] Walter can buy alchemy ingredients from the Pharmacy, if the alchemy skill is unlocked
[*] Special collection access can be gained from Armitage, if Walter has shown him enough occult evidence
[*] Removed empty city events
[*] Better randomization of the city events
[*] Fixed a bug concerning "Anthropogenesis" and "Cosmogenesis" books
[*] Edited Walter's comments about covering the rat hole to make them more logical
[*] Minor fixes to library index cards
[*] Minor typo & grammar fixes
[/list]

If you have any questions or spot any mistakes or bugs, please let me know. 

And a huge thanks to Ténébreux & Ghylard for the French version, and Alejandra for the Spanish version!

Happy Holidays!

Antti
Atom Brain Games

notes.title: Nominate Dreams in the Witch House for the MOST INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY award!
notes.notes:
Nominations for Steam Awards 2023 have started! If you have enjoyed playing Dreams in the Witch House, please consider voting for it for the "[b]Most Innovative Gameplay"[/b] category. 

Or if you don't agree, you could vote for "Best Soundtrack" (Troy's beautiful score is a major part of the atmosphere). Or perhaps even "Best Game You Suck At" if you had a hard time in Arkham.

I know that this weird little game doesn't have much of a chance against the giant AAA-mammoths, but no harm trying, right? Perhaps we can boost the visibility of the game, and introduce new players to it.

This has been a very special year for me. Dreams in the Witch House was my passion project and releasing it was a major achievement for me. But the work hasn't ended yet. The new patch with the French and Spanish fan translations is finally nearing completion. This version also fixes several bugs that you have reported and adds a new feature that several people have requested. So Thank You for your help making Dreams in the Witch House even better!

Antti
Atom Brain Games

notes.title: Dreams in the Witch House - Update now available!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dreamers!

We are thrilled to announce that update 1.06 for Dreams in the Witch House is now available on Steam! This update brings a range of changes and improvements based on your feedback to enhance your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/546ae9dcdf931237225f90eb1dd2074872d321e0.png[/img]

Here are the details:

[list]
[*] Walter can now buy the rat poison directly from the general store, if he has discussed poisoning the rats with Joe.
[*] Earplugs can now deteriorate completely only after sleeping, resting, or studying at home.
[*] An option has been added to disable tutorial texts when starting a new game.
[*] When hovering over an inventory item, the description text will now show how many copies/doses it has.
[*] The Special Collection ending dialog with Armitage now takes into account Walter's Occult skill value.
[*] Occult skill value can no longer be negative.
[*] An issue where it was possible to sign the book of Azathoth several times has been fixed.
[*] An issue where eating canned food at the dream city could decrease Walter's food amount when he is awake has been fixed.
[*] An issue where a corridor exit hotspot could be visible in the dream city, even if the way was blocked, has been fixed.
[*] All mentions of Sarah Churchwell are corrected to Sarah Churchill in the witch trial documents.
[*] If the university basement pipe is burst, Armitage's Special Collection intro sequence can no longer happen in any scenario.
[*] An issue in the Elwood intro sequence where Elwood's sprite might have disappeared briefly has been fixed.
[*] An issue where Elwood could have been incorrectly tinted when encountering him on the street has been fixed.
[*] If the game is paused by pressing spacebar in the index card close-up room, right-clicking no longer freezes the game.
[*] Looking at the strange rod in inventory while in a close-up room no longer freezes the game.
[*] Minor typo fixes have been made.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback, which have helped us identify and address these issues. If you encounter any further problems or have any suggestions, please let us know.

Enjoy the game, and may your dreams be filled with wonder and horror!

-rongel

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902850/Dreams_in_the_Witch_House/

notes.title: END OF YEAR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello!

So as you may already know, Bonus Stage Publishing is helping me to finish the game and spread the word. Feels very nice to have people around me who have done this before!

This change delayed the release a bit, and the new date is in early 2023. The good thing is that I now have a little bit of extra time to polish the game. So here's couple of new special things that have been added already:

[list]
[*] DIFFICULTY LEVELS
There's now three difficulty levels to choose from. They don't affect the puzzles, but change how the survival / RPG stuff works. There's even Ironman mode, if you want extra tension and avoid save scumming.

[*] TWO NEW MUSIC TRACKS
More great music from Troy Sterling Nies that add atmosphere in the game.

[*] CHARACTER BAR STATUS PROGRESSION SYMBOLS
The lines below show the progress to the next status phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/27e90e3fca819420d5998c52b6a713679e054294.png[/img]
This will hopefully make protecting Walter easier. This feature was a suggestion from a player of the demo, so I can't take all the credit :)

[*] BETTER TUTORIALS AND INSTRUCTIONS
New players should have an easier time figuring out how things work. For example, finding study books should now be more intuitive.
[/list]
Before I leave, here's a previously unpublished picture from the game. I can reveal that it is not the ending. I'm not going to spoil that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/a1b978a104b726b1086f314d607732003a51e010.png[/img]

Take care, talk to you soon!

- Antti

notes.title: Prepare for the Lovecraftian Fever Dreams: May-Eve and Witches Are Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[h1]Prepare for the Lovecraftian Fever Dreams: May-Eve and Witches Are Coming Soon[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/859df9882e45b6fbf497f98a8e204e59f7c33779.png[/img]

[h2]Finnish studio with an award-winning lovecraftian short movie announces lovecraftian game The Dreams in the Witch House to be released in early 2023![/h2]

[b]Lapland, Finland - October 27th 2022 -[/b] Finnish game, animation, and film making studio / one man wonder Atom Brain Games are announcing their debut title The Dreams in the Witch House to be released in early 2023. The adventure game is based on the short story written by H.P. Lovecraft.

In the game the player has to survive the nightly terrors for two months, and finally face the May-Eve witch ritual. The game combines RPG and “open world” features to the traditional adventure game genre. The world is alive, and the game play is nonlinear. Many of the  elements are generated randomly, so each play through will be different.

[i]“Couple years ago when I re-read The Dreams in the Witch House by H.P. Lovecraft, I quickly realised that it would make a perfect survival adventure game. Unlike with my previous attempts to finish making a video game, this time my motivation was strong, because of my love for the source material”[/I] says the developer Antti Laakso.

While being an avid H.P. Lovecraft fan, Antti is also a creative powerhouse. Besides co-directing an H.P. Lovecraft film festival’s award winning short film Sound from the Deep, working as an filmmaker, animator and a teacher, he is now a game developer. For the game’s overall creepy feels, Antti teamed up with another fan favourite of Lovecraft genre; Troy Sterling Nies has made the soundtrack for the game.

[h3]Features and gameplay in a nutshell:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unique mix of adventure game and open world survival game
[*] You have 60 days to prepare for the May-Eve witch sabbath
[*] Day / evening / night -cycles
[*] RPG elements: health, sanity, occult & maths skills
[*] Random city activities and encounters
[*] Creeping tension: otherworldly threats intensify gradually
[*] Several endings depending on player’s actions with 10–20 hours of playtime
[*] Plenty of detailed animation and visual effects
[*] Original soundtrack by genre favourite Troy Sterling Nies
[*] 
[/list]
The game will be published by Bonus Stage Publishing in early 2023. [i]“Bonus Stage Publishing is helping me to finish the game and spread the word. I'm very excited and relieved that I have professionals guiding me through this nerve-wrecking period. Feels good to share the load!”[/I] tells Antti Laakso about working together with a publisher and bringing the game out to the world.

notes.title: INTRODUCTION & NEW SCREENSHOT
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

I'm Antti, the solo developer of Dreams in the Witch House, and the person behind Atom Brain Games. 

Dreams in the Witch House is my passion project, and I've been working on it over six years now. 
It's beyond exciting to see the game coming together, and to share it with you!

Obviously, I'm a big Lovecraft fan. While "The Dreams in the Witch House" isn't Lovecraft's most famous story, I believe it's a perfect setting for an open world adventure game. My goal is to make the players feel like they are inside the story, making decisions and choosing their own approach. 

If you haven't read the story, and don't know what I'm talking about, that's okay too! No extra knowledge is required to enjoy the game.

Ok, enough talk! Here's a previously unpublished screenshot from the game. Can you guess the location?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993841/6c4c1ea1edaa4cb6ff384967bc3c7646ff23cede.png[/img]

I'll be happy to answer all your questions about the game, and I'll try to post some updates too!

Take care,

Antti
Atom Brain Games
